review.notes: Triage review: all 58 physical pages machine-scanned (balanced code fences; normalized 4-gram page-text containment vs OCR, mean 0.91; spaced-digit and escape pattern scan); low-containment pages 15, 46-49, 51, 54 inspected line-by-line against extracted PDF text; pages 1, 2, 4 and 46 additionally rendered and visually verified; Table 28 cells diffed one-by-one (all numeric cells match). Two real droppage defects found (Table 28 header row lost its <work> tokens; the epigraph attribution was promoted to a section heading). References spot-checked intact (full author lists present).
